biography.plain_text: Thomas Saylak is an American investor who co-founded Blackstone Real Estate Advisors and later led Merrill Lynch's global commercial real estate business. Educated at Texas A&M and Harvard Business School, he established Teewinot Holdings to manage his family's investments and became chairman of the property investment firm Crystal Creek Capital.

Educated at Texas A&M and Harvard Business School, he established Teewinot Holdings to manage his family's investments and became chairman of the property investment firm Crystal Creek Capital.

confidence.reason: Current official company and institutional biographies support the founding, education, former leadership and family investment platform.

long_biography.plain_text:
American investor Tom Saylak spent his second birthday at Jenny Lake, beginning a family connection to Grand Teton National Park that continued through annual summer visits. His parents built a log cabin near Moose, and after high school he drove its furniture across the country with a friend. Hiking and canoeing remained family traditions.

He served nine years on the Grand Teton National Park Foundation board, including three as vice chair, and returned to the board in 2025. At Texas A&M, he chaired the university foundation and its investment committee. He also endowed a scholarship in honour of his parents.
